import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path


def search_key(title):
    return title.casefold()


def load(path="data/books.json"):
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


def build_export(rows):
    """Search export: one entry per (isbn, edition), inactive stock kept (flagged
    via "active"), ordered by key then identity so output is deterministic and
    independent of storage order."""
    seen = set()
    books = []
    for r in rows:
        ident = (r["isbn"], r["edition"])
        if ident in seen:
            raise ValueError(f"duplicate row identity {ident}")
        seen.add(ident)
        books.append({"isbn": r["isbn"], "edition": r["edition"], "title": r["title"],
                      "active": r["active"], "key": search_key(r["title"])})
    books.sort(key=lambda b: (b["key"], b["isbn"], b["edition"]))
    return {"books": books}


def write_export(out, rows=None):
    data = build_export(load() if rows is None else rows)
    out = Path(out)
    out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    out.write_text(json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n",
                   encoding="utf-8")
    return data


def prefix_search(books, prefix, include_inactive=True):
    """Prefix match against the casefolded key; titles are returned unchanged."""
    p = search_key(prefix)
    return [b for b in books if b["key"].startswith(p) and (include_inactive or b["active"])]


def main(argv):
    if argv and argv[0] == "build":
        out = argv[1] if len(argv) > 1 else "build/search.json"
        data = write_export(out)
        print(f"wrote {out}: {len(data['books'])} books")
    elif argv and argv[0] == "search" and len(argv) >= 2:
        for b in prefix_search(build_export(load())["books"], argv[1],
                               include_inactive="--active-only" not in argv):
            print(f"{b['isbn']}\t{b['edition']}\t{b['title']}\t{'active' if b['active'] else 'inactive'}")
    elif not argv:
        rows = load()
        print(json.dumps({"rows": len(rows), "unique_isbns": len({r["isbn"] for r in rows}),
                          "keys": [search_key(r["title"]) for r in rows]}, ensure_ascii=False))
    else:
        raise SystemExit("usage: python catalog.py [build [OUT] | search PREFIX [--active-only]]")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main(sys.argv[1:])
EOF
cat >> tests/test_catalog.py <<'EOF'


def test_export_keeps_editions_and_original_titles():
    from catalog import build_export
    books = build_export(load())["books"]
    assert len(books) == 4
    atlas = [b for b in books if b["title"] == "Straße Atlas"]
    assert len(atlas) == 2 and all(b["key"] == "strasse atlas" for b in atlas)
    assert len(atlas[0]["key"]) != len(atlas[0]["title"])


def test_prefix_search_uses_folded_key():
    from catalog import build_export, prefix_search
    books = build_export(load())["books"]
    assert len(prefix_search(books, "STRASSE")) == 2
    assert len(prefix_search(books, "Straß")) == 2
    assert [b["title"] for b in prefix_search(books, "APP")] == ["apple Almanac"]
    assert prefix_search(books, "zeb", include_inactive=False) == []
